mechanism: Propylthiouracil-induced hypothyroidism can decrease flecainide metabolism and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk; flecainide may worsen hyperthyroidism if PTU therapy is inadequate.
action: Monitor thyroid function closely, maintain euthyroid state with PTU dosing, monitor flecainide levels and ECG parameters, consider alternative antiarrhythmic if thyroid control is difficult.
